newsitem.title: USA: Thiokol, United Tech in bid venture.
newsitem.headline: Thiokol, United Tech in bid venture.

text.p: Thiokol Corp and United Technologies said they formed a joint venture to support TRW Inc's bid on the United States Air Force's ICBM (intercontinental ballistic missile) Prime Integration contract.

As part of the TRW's team, Thiokol and United Technologies' Chemical Systems Division will combine their solid rocket technology capabilities to provide propulsion system replacement for the Air Force Minuteman III ballistic missile, a major element of the ICBM's integration program, the companies said.
The Air Force issued a request for proposals on the multi-billion dollar program on June 13 and expects to announce a contract award in December, they said.
